business_summary: JSS Corporation engages in the operation of a sports club in Japan. The company researches, develops, plans, manages, and operates sports clubs, such as swimming schools, tennis schools, and fitness clubs, as well as offers related consulting services; sells, repairs, and maintains sporting goods, equipment, and accessory and auxiliary equipment, as well as processing machines and facilities; travel services; processes machines and equipment; holds, plans, manages, and operates cram school classes, sports classes, culture classes, and health promotion classes; and develops and sells computers, software, and terminal equipment. It is involved in the construction work business, building planning and design, civil engineering, steel structure, pipe work, and machinery installation and design works; real estate rental business; sale of metal product and machinery equipment, health equipment, beauty equipment, and medical equipment; marketing business, such as research, analysis, and consulting related to the market and advertisement; planning, production, manufacturing, leasing, distribution, sales, and import/export of audio/visual software, such as music tapes, video tapes, compact discs, and DVDs; and labor dispatch business. In addition, the company sells and exports clothing, food, cosmetics, books, stationeries, toys, quasi-drugs, sanitary products, daily necessities, and decorative items; offers security, maintenance inspection, and cleaning services for internal and external facilities of various buildings, as well as health checkups and guidance services. Further, it manages restaurants; purchase and sells secondhand items; and plans, designs, and implements various events, seminars, and training sessions, as well as provides temporary childcare services. The company was formerly known as Japan Swimming Service Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JSS Corporation in June 1991. JSS Corporation was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: JSS Corporation은 일본에서 스포츠 클럽을 운영하고 있습니다. 수영학원, 테니스학원, 피트니스클럽 등 스포츠 클럽을 연구, 개발, 기획, 관리, 운영하고 관련 컨설팅 서비스를 제공하는 회사입니다. 스포츠 용품, 장비, 액세서리 및 보조 장비, 가공 기계 및 시설을 판매, 수리 및 유지 관리합니다. 여행 서비스; 기계 및 장비를 처리합니다. 학원강좌, 스포츠강좌, 문화강좌, 건강증진강좌 등을 개최, 기획, 관리, 운영합니다. 컴퓨터, 소프트웨어, 단말 장비를 개발 및 판매합니다. 건설공사사업, 건축계획 및 설계, 토목공사, 철골구조, 배관공사, 기계설치 및 설계업무에 종사하고 있습니다. 부동산 임대업; 금속 제품 및 기계 장비, 건강 장비, 미용 장비 및 의료 장비 판매; 시장 및 광고에 관한 조사, 분석, 컨설팅 등 마케팅 사업 뮤직테이프, 비디오테이프, 콤팩트디 등 오디오/비디오 소프트웨어의 기획, 제작, 제조, 임대, 유통, 판매, 수출입업
